newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal closes higher on China rumors.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal closes higher on China rumors.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures closed higher on commercial buying, rumors China was buying U.S. soymeal and on gains in soybeans, traders said.
Traders said there was talk China purchased 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal overnight Wednesday and another 50,000 tonnes overnight Thursday.
Continental Grain bought 400 lots of October and bought 800 December, traders said, while Cargill Inc bought 200 lots of October and 100 December.
However, U.S. exporters said they could not confirm that soymeal had been sold to China.
Soyoil ended firm on the gains in meal and soy.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 18,000 contracts, down from 22,502 contracts Thursday. Soymeal options volume was estimated at 1,800 contracts, down from 2,079 Thursday.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 15,000 contracts, down from 19,483 Thursday. Soyoil options volume was estimated at 800 contracts, down from 1,375 Thursday.
Soymeal closed $1.30 to $3.00 a ton higher, with September up $1.60 at $267.70 a ton. Soyoil was 0.13 to 0.28 cent per lb higher, with September up 0.13 at 25.50 cents.
